title: ArcCivs creative profession-tool issuance correction
assumptions: Source before d8364fd: creative request button required an existing tool in player storage; an empty creative inventory could issue zero. After: one plain requested iron tool is created and equipped per accepted request; its existing replacement is retained in the bag.

This is creative administration, not ordinary player income. Survival continues exact native-item transfers and cannot mint. The request disappears once the correct tool is equipped; repeated clicks and crash recovery reuse durable state. Creative players already have unrestricted native item creation.

Sensitivity only: 1/2/4 creative operators, 1/4/12 accepted requests per operator-day (0.25/1/2 active hours, 4/4/6 actions per hour). Not telemetry and not an implemented daily cap. One request equals one profession tool, including the requested iron pickaxe; no money conversion.

Farm correction prioritizes mature crops through complete bounded scans and removes zero-change watering. Exposed rain suppresses every watering action, including the former free age3-to4 boost; covered or dry-weather care retains that boost and age5 fertilizing retains its real bone-meal debit. Harvest starvation repair may raise realized collections; removing exposed-rain bonuses may lower growth relative to baseline in rain. Neither effect is assigned invented throughput. Existing drop quantities, four-second care duration and profession rewards are unchanged. Motion and transient chunk retry do not change construction cost or paid receipt identity.
Direct Vault, tokens and player XP deltas are zero. Current SELL and planned future SELL-to-contract transition remain outside scope; no duplicate item redemption is modeled.

flows.basis: Explicit creative-only request, one exact requested tool in resident main hand; ordinary survival transfer unchanged.
